meta.title: Sakina · Anonymous peer support
meta.description: Read real stories, find your community and share when you are ready. Anonymous peer support, not medical care.

notFound.title: This page isn't here yet
notFound.body: It may be coming soon, or the link is wrong. Help is still one tap away.

crisis.title: If you are in danger right now
crisis.body: Please contact emergency services or someone you trust. You don't need an account for this.
crisis.placeholder: [To be added after verification with local partners]
crisis.ground1: Put both feet on the floor. Notice it holding you.
crisis.ground2: Breathe in for 4, out for 6. Do it three times.
crisis.ground3: Name five things you can see around you.
crisis.notEmergency: Sakina is not an emergency service. Therapists here cannot send help to your location.

footer.note: Sakina is anonymous peer support. It is not medical care, therapy, diagnosis or an emergency service. If you are in danger, use Get help now.

sensitivityNote.high: This space talks about heavy topics. Difficult details sit behind a content note until you choose to read them, and you can stop at any time.

page.rule2: No diagnoses or medication advice for others.
page.rule3: Keep names, places and contact details out.
page.crisisTitle: If you are not safe right now
page.crisisBody: You don't need an account to get help.

home.sub: Choose what you are going through, read real stories from people who understand, and share when you are ready. No real name, no phone number.
home.safe1b: Sakina connects people with shared experiences. Every post passes a safety check, and risky messages go to a therapist first.
home.safe2b: Verified psychologists and psychiatrists guide some rooms and read flagged posts. They listen and guide; they never diagnose or prescribe here.
home.safe3b: If you are in danger, you don't need an account. Help options are on every page.

communities.title: Communities
communities.sub: One place for each experience. Read freely; join to take part.

password.hint: At least 8 characters. Longer phrases with a number or symbol are stronger.

design.title: Design system
design.sub: Every token and component Sakina is built from, live. Switch language and theme to check each one in Arabic, French and English, light and dark.

sections.general: Menus, tooltips, search, steps, tables and tiles

design.tokensNote: Theme tokens. These change with light and dark mode; components only use these names.
design.colorRule: Pastels are for surfaces and illustration. Text uses ink, or the deep ink tints on soft fills, at 4.5:1 contrast or better. Crisis and errors use terracotta, never alarm red.
design.sample: Someone else has walked this path before.
design.typeNote: English and French: Bricolage Grotesque for headings, Instrument Sans for text, JetBrains Mono for labels. Arabic: Cairo for headings, IBM Plex Sans Arabic for text, no letter spacing. Wordmark: Reem Kufi.
design.buttonsNote: One primary button per view. Every target is at least 44px. Arrows and send icons mirror in Arabic.

forms.nicknameHint: 3 to 20 characters. Arabic letters are welcome.
forms.nicknameTaken: That nickname is taken. Try another.
forms.recCodeHint: A one-time code you keep somewhere safe.
forms.recEmailHint: Stored encrypted. Never shown to members or therapists.
forms.allowDmHint: People can ask; you still decide.

selection.panelStories: Stories panel. Arrow keys move between tabs.

notices.infoBody: For the first days, posting is a little slower.
notices.warnBody: Please remove the phone number before posting.

states.emptyBody: Be the first to share. Your words may help someone tonight.
states.errorBody: It is not you. Check your connection and try again. Your draft is safe.

overlays.dialogBody: It disappears for everyone, along with its replies.

design.crisisNote: Crisis help sits in the header, footer and key screens, signed in or not. Numbers stay as placeholders until verified with local partners.
design.productNote: Member text keeps its own direction: an Arabic story reads right to left inside the French or English interface.

w.tooltip: Only you can see your saved stories.
w.confirmBody: They can still read and get help, and they can appeal once.
w.confirmHint: Required. It is saved in the audit log.
w.confirmDone: Suspended. The reason is in the audit log.
w.openGate: Try to react as a guest
w.reported: Thank you. A moderator will look at this.

nickname.label: Nickname
nickname.hint: 3 to 20 characters: letters, numbers, dot or underscore. Arabic letters are welcome. Don't use your real name.
nickname.taken: That nickname is taken. Try another.
nickname.invalid: Use 3 to 20 letters, numbers, dots or underscores.

recovery.onceTitle: We show this code only once
recovery.onceBody: Write it down or save it in a password manager. Sakina staff cannot see it or send it again.
recovery.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please select the code instead.
recovery.saved: I saved my recovery code somewhere safe

gate.body: Reading stays open to everyone. Taking part needs an anonymous account:
gate.only: Just a nickname and a password

lockout.body: Too many tries. For your safety, try again in {time}, or recover your account now.

report.title: Report this
report.body: Reports are private. The author is not told who reported.
report.private: If someone may be in danger, choose the first option: a therapist sees it right away.

replies.hint: Replies go through the same safety check as posts.
replies.placeholder: Respond with care. Share your experience, not advice.
replies.tooShort: Write a little more before posting.
replies.none: No replies yet. A kind word can mean a lot.
replies.heldOnlyYou: Only you can see this until a therapist checks it

draft.auto: Drafts save automatically as you write.

held.title: Thank you for trusting us with this.
held.body: Your words are safe with us. A therapist will read them soon. They aren't public yet.
held.body2: If you are in danger right now, please use Get help now. You can also sit in a room with others while you wait.

message.held: Only you can see this until a therapist checks it

rule.guided: Guided by a therapist. Listening is welcome. No advice on medication or diagnosis.
rule.peer: Peer room watched by moderators. Be kind, keep everyone anonymous.
rule.dm: Private 1:1 chat. You can block or report at any time.

composer.label: Write a message
composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift and Enter for a new line.
composer.tooLong: Messages can be up to 1000 characters.

dm.title: Ask {nickname} for a 1:1 chat
dm.body: They can accept or decline. Your request stays private.

minute.label: Guided minute of breathing
minute.hint: Follow the circle. Nothing else to do.

common.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

aside.privateBody: Your recovery email, age range and country. Admins only see what they need for safety, and every admin action is logged.
aside.limitsBody: For the first days, posting is a little slower and 1:1 requests are off. Limits lift as you take part.
aside.demoBody: This is a prototype with test accounts. Password for all: <x>calm-river-22</x>
aside.passkeyBody: Soon you'll be able to sign in with your device instead of a password.
aside.whyBody: Anonymity protects you. Your recovery code or email is the only link between you and your account.

signup.title: Create your anonymous account
signup.s1Body: Choose one or more communities. You can change this anytime, and nobody else sees your choice.
signup.picked: {count, plural, =0 {None selected yet} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
signup.s2Body: Pick a nickname that doesn't include your real name. Your avatar is an abstract gradient, never a photo.
signup.privateDefault: Age range and country are private by default. You decide later whether to show them.
signup.s3Body: A password, and a way back in if you forget it. We never ask for a phone number.
signup.passkeyLater: Passkeys (signing in with your device) are coming later.
signup.recBody: Required. It's the only way back into an anonymous account.
signup.recCodeHint: A one-time code you keep somewhere safe. No email needed.
signup.recEmailHint: Stored encrypted. Never shown to members or therapists.
signup.emailHint: Encrypted. Members and therapists never see it; admins only see it masked.
signup.care: I understand Sakina is peer support, not medical care, therapy or an emergency service.

errors.adult: Sakina is for adults 18 and over.

forgot.useEmail: Send a link to my recovery email

forgot.noneBody: Because accounts are anonymous, we can't confirm who you are another way. You can start a new account; help is always available.
forgot.codeBody: Enter your nickname and recovery code.

forgot.codeWrong: That nickname and recovery code don't match.

forgot.simulateHint: In the real product the link arrives by email. Here you can open it directly.
forgot.badLinkBody: It may have expired, or the details didn't match an account.
forgot.newCodeBody: Your old code no longer works.
